accordions.html:

Always wash hands, attach a new needle, and prime the pen before use.

Inject at a 90° angle into the abdomen, thigh, or upper arm.

Hold the pen in place for 5–10 seconds before removing it.

Inject once weekly and rotate injection sites each week.

Store unopened pens at 2–8°C in the original packaging and do not freeze.

After use, remove the needle, recap the pen, never store it with the needle attached, and keep it out of reach of children.

Rotate injection sites weekly.
